# As of 2026-08-20 (FAL-04 RESOLVED **PARTIALLY** at window close): **1 CONFIRMED / 2 FAILED / 1 PARTIALLY / 0 VOIDED / 0 OPEN.** ⚠️ READ THE GRADE'S REASON BEFORE READING IT AS CALIBRATION: FAL-04 did NOT miss — no registered route fired and the substantive crude/condensate claim HELD for the full window. It is capped at PARTIALLY by its OWN Jazan resolvability guard, whose two branches ((i) restarted-and-normal / (ii) extended-into-crude) BOTH failed to obtain, because the world landed in a third state the guard never enumerated: the outage PERSISTED but stayed MOLECULE-CONFINED (Aramco pushed the Jazan restart to 8/30; a refinery outage cuts crude RUNS and if anything FREES crude for export). ⇒ DESIGN LESSON FOR EVERY SUCCESSOR: a resolvability guard written as a CLOSED two-option menu converts diligence into a downgrade when the modal outcome is off-menu [[finding_option_menu_omitting_the_owners_choice_reads_as_silence]]. Successors MUST carry a third branch: 'outage persists AND is affirmatively confined to excluded molecules => contributes to CONFIRMED.' ⚠️ NO ROW IS OPEN — a FAL-05 successor is OWED and its absence is a gap, not a clean slate.
# As of 2026-07-30 (FAL-03 RESOLVED **FAILED** on day 4 of 21; FAL-04 REGISTERED): **1 CONFIRMED / 2 FAILED / 0 PARTIALLY / 0 VOIDED / 1 OPEN.**

# ⚠️ **READ THIS BEFORE READING THE SCOREBOARD AS CALIBRATION. FAL-03 IS NOT A NORMAL MISS AND COUNTING IT AS ONE OVERSTATES MY CALIBRATION WHILE UNDERSTATING THE PROBLEM.** It failed on TWO routes: (b) JAZAN — Aramco shut the 400 kbpd refinery 7/27 (Reuters/IIR), a genuine in-window development and a real forecasting miss; and (a) RAS LAFFAN — a QatarEnergy force majeure on LNG deliveries **live since 2026-03-24, serially extended, and extended again to Asian buyers 7/28**. Route (a) **was already satisfied on the day the row was written.** FAL-03 could never have resolved CONFIRMED. I registered a KILL-SWITCH that was already tripped, marked it OPEN, and kept exporting the thesis it was supposed to guard. **That is a research failure, not a calibration failure, and the 58% was never a real number.**

# ROOT CAUSE (two, and the second generalizes): (1) I asserted an UNCHECKED NEGATIVE — STATUS carried "R2 active force majeure in-theater: None current (Bapco + Ras Laffan were March)". I knew the strike; I treated a March **EVENT** as a closed **STATE** and never asked whether the FM had been LIFTED. An event has a date; a force majeure has a DURATION. (2) **I WIDENED THE SCOPE AND KEPT A NARROW INSTRUMENT** — FAL-03 broadened to "oil/gas" to fix FAL-01's actor gap, but its 58% was derived off `STRIKES.tsv`, an OIL-COMPLEX STRIKE ledger that structurally cannot see a live LNG force majeure (an FM is not a strike; LNG is not oil). The "ZERO across 109 days" that carried the derivation was an artifact of the instrument's blind spot. **FORWARD RULE, now FAL-04's first design condition: when you widen a prediction's scope, RE-SCOPE THE BASE-RATE INSTRUMENT TO MATCH, or state in the row what the instrument cannot see.**

# WORDING-WEDGE FAMILY, FIFTH INSTANCE: HAW-10 (locus) → HAW-14 (catalyst) → HAW-15 (mechanism) → FAL-01 (actor) → **FAL-03 (MOLECULE + EVENT-vs-STATE)**. Each fix closed its own axis and exposed the next; FAL-01's "enumerate the BELLIGERENTS" was done correctly and did not help, because nobody had yet said **enumerate the MOLECULES, and say whether you mean a NEW loss or ANY loss.** FAL-04 does both, plus stated-vs-realized duration.

# THESIS CONSEQUENCE (the corrected export — do NOT re-broadcast the unqualified version): "risk-PREMIUM regime, not supply-LOSS regime" was never MOLECULE-SCOPED. Once scoped it **HOLDS FOR CRUDE** (zero confirmed crude-production barrels offline; Petroline operational; Brent $90.21 on 7/30, ~10% below the 7/23 peak) and **FAILS FOR GAS** (Ras Laffan, since March) **and REFINED PRODUCT** (Jazan, 7/27). FAL-04 tests the crude leg only, and says so.

# Prior header (as of 2026-07-27 session 2 — FAL-03 REGISTERED, closing the empty-ledger gap): 1 CONFIRMED / 1 FAILED / 0 PARTIALLY / 0 VOIDED / 1 OPEN. FAL-03 is FAL-01's successor and discharges all three registered conditions: confidence RE-DERIVED at 58% (the 70% was not consulted — regime-split base rate + two-leg decomposition, full derivation in thesis/FAL-01_REREGISTRATION_SCAFFOLD.md); class test written as an OPERATIONAL THRESHOLD (FM / >=100k bpd for >=7d / loadings suspended >=72h) rather than an exemplar list, per HAWK's 7/25 rec which PREDATES the FAL-01 resolution; and the FOUR belligerent axes the confidence is priced off are enumerated in the Invalidation column, with a fifth-actor RE-REGISTRATION clause — the actor axis is what broke FAL-01 and it is now explicit. Registered as the KILL-SWITCH for the load-bearing "risk-PREMIUM regime, not supply-LOSS regime" thesis, with a pre-registered resolvability guard so that operator SILENCE cannot auto-confirm it.

# INHERITED CALIBRATION LESSONS (per build spec MANIFEST_C §2 — read before writing the next prediction; full detail in the frozen HAWK record):

#   HAW-06 @ 70% (FAILED) — DEFERRAL-DYNAMIC ANCHOR: this conflict produces armed pauses via ally-request deferrals, not clean breaks. Don't over-predict clean state-changes on deadline-shaped events. PRIMARY inheritor: FALCON (spec-named).

#   HAW-07 (VOIDED) — VOIDED-vs-CONFIRMED discipline: a conditional prediction whose premise fails is VOIDED, not CONFIRMED, even if the outcome happens to land right for unrelated reasons (no right-for-wrong-reasons credit). Unconditional predictions have NO void path.
#   HAW-08/HAW-09 (CONFIRMED) — pre-registration + action-based rubric discipline: set the resolution rubric BEFORE evidence search; a 2nd independent path neutralizes a contamination caveat.

#   HAW-10 (FAILED) — WORDING-IDENTITY discipline: when a prediction and a vector promotion-threshold describe the same event, write ONE canonical sentence and reference it from both places; on conflict, the registered PREDICTIONS.tsv text is canonical.

#   HAW-11 (FAILED, kill-switch) — KILL-SWITCH FRAMING: a thesis-load-bearing prediction can be registered as the explicit falsification test for a cross-file thesis (here: FLOW-HAWK-19 decoupling); if it fires, the channel was dormant not muted; if it expires, the thesis is reinforced. Frame new kill-switch predictions the same way (see FAL-01).

#   HAW-14 (FAILED, RE-SCOPED) — LOCUS-vs-MECHANISM: write the mechanism, not the trigger/locus. A Lebanon-locus-clause prediction would have closed CONFIRMED while the underlying "Iran direct-kinetic-on-US/Israel" floor breached 4x via other catalysts — a calibration artifact. PRIMARY inheritor: FALCON (source event).

#   CROSS-CUTTING (applies to FALCON, OSPREY, and HAWK-synthesis alike — spec explicitly names this all-three): MECHANISM-NOT-TARGET + OWN-LEDGER-STALENESS (from HAW-15, OSPREY's primary lesson but the failure class is general) — search the underlying mechanism broadly (not just a prediction's named literal targets), and never trust your own ledger as a baseline without checking its own Last-Updated / completeness first. A first-pass "no results" is a search-coverage statement, not a fact.
